objective:
Add the two ledger operations the first phone screens need: a history read and an occurrence hide (for Undo).

BACKGROUND: `ActivityRepository` (core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mcfrenchpants/activityledger/core/domain/repository/ActivityRepository.kt, types in RepositoryTypes.kt) is the domain's persistence contract. It is implemented by `RoomActivityRepository` (core-data) and by `InMemoryActivityRepository` (core-testing, used by JVM tests). core-domain is pure Kotlin with NO coroutines dependency and must stay that way: new functions are `suspend`, not Flow. Room writes all go through `LedgerWriteDao` / `ActivityLedgerWriter` (the read DAOs are read-only; `DaoWriteSurfaceGuardTest` enforces this). Read the KDoc error contract at the top of ActivityRepository and follow it.

DO:
1. core-domain: add to `ActivityRepository`, with KDoc in the file's style:
   a. `suspend fun loadHistory(): List<HistoryEntry>` -- one entry per raw capture that EITHER has an occurrence whose visibility is ACTIVE, OR has no occurrence at all. A capture whose occurrence is HIDDEN is omitted. Ordered newest first by the occurrence's occurred_at (captures with an occurrence) or the capture's captured_at (captures without one), ties broken by capture id descending. Must use a bounded number of queries regardless of row count (no query per row).
   b. `suspend fun hideOccurrence(occurrenceId: String)` -- sets that occurrence's visibility ACTIVE -> HIDDEN and its updated_at from the repository's own clock. Already HIDDEN: no-op, writes nothing. Unknown id: IllegalArgumentException, nothing written. Never touches raw captures, interpretations, corrections or activities. Hiding is NOT a correction (DATA_MODEL: corrections have no visibility columns): no correction row.
2. core-domain RepositoryTypes.kt: add `HistoryEntry` (data class): captureId, rawText, source (CaptureSource), capturedAt (Instant), zoneId (ZoneId), processingState (ProcessingState), occurrence (`HistoryOccurrence?`), pendingMatchedActivityId (String? -- only for a capture with no occurrence: the matched_activity_id of its most recently created interpretation, or null). `HistoryOccurrence`: occurrenceId, activityId, activityDisplayName, occurredAt, timePrecision, activityState. The activity shown is the occurrence's CURRENT canonical activity (so an occurrence moved by a correction shows the corrected activity's name).
3. core-data: implement both in RoomActivityRepository. Reads via new @Query methods on the existing read DAOs (or a dedicated read-only query DAO/POJO if cleaner). The hide write goes in LedgerWriteDao as a @Transaction operation surfaced through ActivityLedgerWriter like the existing writes, not as a free @Update on a read DAO. Keep DaoWriteSurfaceGuardTest passing -- if that guard enumerates allowed write methods, extend its allow-list for the new method and explain in your report.
4. NO schema change: no new entity, column or index, the exported schema JSON under core-data/schemas must be unchanged, SchemaVersionConsistencyTest green. If you conclude a query really needs an index, STOP and report status scope_change_requested instead.
5. core-testing: implement both in InMemoryActivityRepository with identical behaviour (ordering, omission, pendingMatchedActivityId, hide semantics and errors).
6. Tests:
   - core-data RoomActivityRepositoryTest (or a new test file beside it): ordering across mixed occurrence/no-occurrence captures; tie-break; HIDDEN omitted; no-occurrence captures in NEEDS_REVIEW, FAILED_RETRYABLE, FAILED_FINAL and CAPTURED appear with their state; pendingMatchedActivityId = latest interpretation's matched id (two interpretations, latest wins; null when none); corrected occurrence shows the new activity name; hide ACTIVE->HIDDEN then omitted from history; hide twice is a no-op (updated_at unchanged the second time); unknown id throws and writes nothing; hide leaves raw_captures, interpretations and corrections row counts/content unchanged.
   - core-testing InMemoryActivityRepositoryTest: the same behaviours (mirrored, can be fewer cases but must cover ordering, omission, pending id, hide idempotence, unknown id).
7. Any other class implementing ActivityRepository (grep; none expected beyond the two) must compile.

PRIVACY (AGENTS.md #11): no logging; exception messages carry ids and enum names only, never raw text or activity names.

DEVICE SAFETY: this task needs no device. Never run adb or any connected* Gradle task. Set ANDROID_SERIAL=none-for-this-task in the environment of every Gradle command you run.
non_goals: No UI and no app-phone change.
No schema change, migration, new entity, column or index.
No Flow / coroutines dependency in core-domain.
No change to existing repository functions' behaviour.
No change to BACKLOG.md, PROGRESS.md, docs/, .sdlc, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md. Do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: ActivityRepository has loadHistory() and hideOccurrence(occurrenceId) as suspend functions with KDoc; HistoryEntry and HistoryOccurrence types exist in RepositoryTypes.kt; core-domain gains no dependency.

RoomActivityRepository and InMemoryActivityRepository implement both with the same behaviour: ACTIVE-occurrence and no-occurrence captures only, HIDDEN omitted, newest first with capture-id tie-break, pendingMatchedActivityId from the latest interpretation, current (corrected) activity name.
loadHistory uses a bounded number of queries independent of row count.

hideOccurrence: ACTIVE->HIDDEN with updated_at; already HIDDEN is a no-op; unknown id throws IllegalArgumentException and writes nothing; no raw capture, interpretation, correction or activity row touched; no correction row created.
The hide write lives in LedgerWriteDao/ActivityLedgerWriter as a transaction; read DAOs stay read-only and DaoWriteSurfaceGuardTest passes.
No schema change: core-data/schemas unchanged, SchemaVersionConsistencyTest and migration tests green.
New tests cover every behaviour listed in the objective's step 6, and all module tests pass.
No logging; exception messages contain ids/enum names only.
Only write_paths changed; no device contact.
